action_timeline.rationale: Depends on the executed grant; the model's first lower outer raider reaches column 5 shortly afterward.
Requires first upper central raider clearance and survival through the opening shells.
Requires observed western upper roadblock destruction.
Requires eastern lower roadblock destruction and a safe transition to the western interception tile.
Requires the preceding lower central queue to be dead; no later Vanilla grant is counted.

battle_phases.completion_condition: At frame 1200 all four corridors remain intercepted, no leak has occurred, and the first upper central raider is dead.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A lost interception, missing grant or unsafe civilian detention rejects the opening and invalidates its resource chain.
battle_phases.goal: Establish four interceptions without repeating the shared-shell opening collapse.
handoff_requirements: Beagle's successful retreat supplies the verified refund for Noir Corne.
The predecessor's enemy queue must be cleared or immediately recaptured.
responsibilities: Vanilla survives the lower opening and supplies the first executed grant.
GALLUS, Friston and Plume establish outer clearance and blocking.
battle_phases.start_condition: Stage begins with 10 DP and no deployed operators.
survival_dependencies: Beagle survives until his funded withdrawal.
Friston survives the first upper outer raider under actual targeting.
Eastern upper civilian detention is cleared before nearby officers can attack its occupant.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Both professional medics are treating their assigned sides, upper roadblocks are destroyed, the first civilian has safely arrived, and Spot replaces Friston.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A dead temporary blocker or uncleared roadblock prevents the planned handoff; subsequent deployments do not repair that earlier protection failure.
battle_phases.goal: Establish sustained professional treatment and release the first protected target.
handoff_requirements: Jnight leaves only after confirmed western upper clearance.
Spot moves interception west while maintaining officer separation from remaining detention.
responsibilities: Hibiscus assumes upper treatment after clearance.
GALLUS remains available for eastern attacks and artillery opportunities.
battle_phases.start_condition: The opening completion predicate holds and all temporary blockers are alive.
survival_dependencies: Noir Corne survives until Beagle's return; uninterrupted shell focus is not assumed survivable.
Lower interception holds before Ansel's first actual heal.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Midnight owns lower outer interception, both lower roadblocks are destroyed, Beagle has legally returned, both arts positions are staffed, and Cardigan replaces Vanilla.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: An unsafe release, cooldown violation or failed replacement invalidates protection or final-wave interception.
battle_phases.goal: Complete lower civilian clearance and establish the final eight-operator formation.
handoff_requirements: Professional healing exists before Lancet leaves.
Plume's eastern roadblock duty completes before withdrawal.
Vanilla's queue is clear before her final retreat.
responsibilities: Midnight clears western lower detention without ordinary civilian blocking.
Durin and Steward accumulate target-specific artillery damage.
Cardigan assumes the cleared lower central choke.
battle_phases.start_condition: Professional coverage and surviving corridor ownership are established.
survival_dependencies: The second civilian is not killed by a locked artillery projectile or nearby officer.
Both casters receive actual healing when damaged.
Each retreating operator survives until departure.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Remaining life is positive, leaks and protected deaths are zero, both protected targets safely arrived, spawns are exhausted and no active enemies remain.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Any leak, protected death, missing protected arrival or surviving escaping artillery rejects the plan.
battle_phases.goal: Clear the final waves and artillery while completing both protected objectives.
handoff_requirements: Do not withdraw clearance or protection support merely because the last model spawn occurred.
Continue terminal observation beyond frame 12000 if any acceptance component remains unresolved.
responsibilities: Use scheduled supported skills without assuming active-time SP recovery.
Keep both casters and both medics deployed until their duties are actually complete.
Track outstanding artillery projectiles independently of artillery death.
battle_phases.start_condition: The final formation is established and no prior acceptance condition has failed.
survival_dependencies: Ground queues remain within block capacity.
Actual caster artillery output is sufficient before its route ends.
Medical target selection sustains the units actually taking damage.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: GALLUS, then Steward, and later Durin attack actual visible artillery opportunities. Medics sustain their respective sides. Neither damage totals against other targets nor elapsed time establish artillery clearance.

GALLUS damages eastern upper detention; Jnight clears western upper detention. Observe both destructions and the civilian's safe arrival. Friston at column 5 is unsafe for a civilian still detained at column 6 when an officer arrives.
Plume damages eastern lower detention; Midnight clears western lower detention while holding at column 4. Confirm release and safe arrival rather than inferring either from attacks.
Beagle, Noir Corne, then returning Beagle own upper central blocking. Jnight initially provides supporting damage.
Vanilla, then Cardigan own lower central blocking under Ansel's eventual treatment.
Friston, then Spot own upper outer blocking. GALLUS and the later upper caster supply approaching-target damage where actually in range.
Plume, then Midnight own lower outer blocking; Midnight's arts windows support queue reduction.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Initial and returning upper central defender.
Lower central opening and observed DP grants.
Deployment recovery and ordinary upper treatment.
Eastern upper roadblock damage, upper outer support and incidental artillery damage.
Temporary upper outer interception; no talent mitigation credited.
Initial lower outer interception and adjacent eastern roadblock damage.
Upper central bridge during Beagle's cooldown.
Western upper roadblock clearance and upper central supporting attacks.
Permanent upper professional treatment after Justice Knight leaves.
Permanent lower treatment covering both lower blockers and the later caster.
Three-block upper outer replacement, two columns from either upper roadblock.
Two-block lower outer replacement and western lower roadblock clearance.
Sustained arts against the artillery's eastern row-5 visits.
Sustained arts against eastern row-2 artillery visits and upper approaching hostiles.
Fresh three-block lower central defender for the final pressure.

formation_structure.artillery_policy: Keep the eastern arts positions supplied with ordinary healing. Record actual artillery damage separately from attacks on roadblocks and ground enemies. Preserve the formation until artillery death is observed; no fixed kill deadline or assumed target priority is used.

economy.basis: Initial 10 DP, natural recovery, successfully executed Vanilla grants, and refunds from successful retreats only.
economy.catalog_cost_policy: Use supplied costs without unsupported discounts. Current-model redeployment uses base cost plus a supported deployment-cost delta.
economy.dependency: These balances require the listed successful grants and retreats. A dead income operator, failed clearance withdrawal or missing refund invalidates the downstream handoff.

formation_structure.lower_outer: Plume damages the eastern lower roadblock from column 5. Midnight subsequently intercepts at column 4 and faces LEFT to clear the western roadblock.
formation_structure.medical_geometry: Hibiscus RIGHT at [2,2] covers the upper defender, upper outer blocker and [2,5] caster. Ansel RIGHT at [5,2] covers [4,3], [6,4] and [5,5]. Their ordinary ranges do not provide mutual professional healing.
formation_structure.opening: Beagle establishes upper interception before the first raider. Vanilla holds the lower central route at [4,3], diagonally separated from [3,4]. Lancet's [2,3] position is outside a radius-1.2 blast centered on Beagle.
formation_structure.slots: Peak occupancy is eight. Jnight leaves before Hibiscus; Lancet leaves before Durin; GALLUS leaves before Steward. Same-tile exchanges execute retreat before deployment.
formation_structure.upper_outer: Friston initially blocks at column 5 with GALLUS supporting. Spot subsequently intercepts at column 4, separating detained officers from both upper roadblocks.

formation_transitions.transition: Replace the vanguard-first upper opening with Beagle.
Lancet restores damaged opening units and begins upper treatment.
Vanilla's first grant funds lower outer interception.
After the first upper central raider is dead, Beagle retreats and Noir Corne takes the same choke.
After western upper roadblock destruction, Jnight yields its tile to Hibiscus; GALLUS remains deployed.
Ansel establishes independent lower professional treatment.
Friston yields to Spot one column farther west.
Plume yields to Midnight one column farther west; Midnight begins western lower clearance.
Beagle returns after the complete 2100-frame cooldown and replaces Noir Corne.
Lancet leaves after professional coverage is established; Durin adds eastern artillery damage.
GALLUS yields its eastern upper position to Steward.
After the lower central queue is cleared, Cardigan replaces Vanilla. No subsequent Vanilla income is budgeted.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Every selected operator belongs to normal_low_star_catalog, has identity.rarity 1–3 and qualification.normal_mode true; no mode-specific reserve unit is selected.
Every deployment uses its listed legal ground or high-ground [row,col] tile and cardinal direction. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Safe arrival must be observed for both expected protected targets.

Roadblock clearance and officer distance are independent duties. In particular, an officer held at [1,5] can threaten a civilian detained at [1,6]; eastern clearance must be observed before treating that interception as protective.
For every artillery lock, evaluate the actual locked point and radius-1.2 victim set. Do not infer target ordering or universal single-victim safety from the planned spacing.
Vanilla must survive and execute each budgeted grant. Failure is a survival dependency failure, not permission to reconstruct income.
Noir Corne and Friston must remain alive until their replacements. Neither is certified to absorb uninterrupted artillery focus. Loss of either invalidates its fixed downstream handoff.
Each planned retreat requires a living predecessor, sufficient actual DP, a ready replacement and an interception gap that cannot leak. Do not credit refunds for death.
Do not rely on same-frame retreat versus lethal-impact ordering. If a lethal shell arrives before a funded safe handoff, record the candidate as failed rather than inventing an evacuation.
Use actual ordinary ranges and observed healing targets. Unsupported talents, equal-ratio tie-breaks and cross-map professional healing are not assumed.
Occupancy never exceeds eight. Beagle's frame-3210 return follows his actual frame-1110 retreat by 2100 frames.
Require remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and exactly two safe protected arrivals. Track operator deaths separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Prove defender survival, establish all four interceptions, and observe whether eastern upper detention clears before officers threaten its civilian.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: A missing grant or lost blocker rejects the opening and its downstream ledger.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Sustain the temporary upper defenders, clear western upper detention, establish both professional medics, and replace outer blockers.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: Healing events alone do not validate temporary blocker survival, civilian separation or queue control.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Clear western lower detention, complete Beagle's legal return, establish both sustained arts positions, and replace Vanilla after clearing her queue.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: An unsafe release, unsupported refund or missing replacement invalidates the corresponding protection and clearance handoff.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Hold four corridors through the final 211-second model spawn, sustain artillery attackers and verify complete project acceptance.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: Extend observation when required; a leak, protected death or artillery escape rejects the candidate.

skill_intents.intent: First readiness follows 14 inactive seconds after frame 570. Subsequent activations include ten active seconds and twenty recharge seconds. Credit six DP only on successful execution.
Use supported ATK and attack-speed enhancement after 45 inactive seconds; no benefit persists after retreat.
Thirty initial inactive seconds; later cycles include twenty active and thirty recharge seconds.
Twenty-five initial inactive seconds; later cycles include twenty-five active and thirty-five recharge seconds. Ordinary lower coverage remains the baseline.
Forty initial inactive seconds from deployment SP 30; later cycles include forty active and seventy recharge seconds. Use supported arts conversion without probability talent credit.
Returning deployment charges for forty inactive seconds. Later cycles include thirty active and forty recharge seconds.
Allow supported automatic attack-SP enhanced hits. Do not assume highest-defense targeting.
Use ordinary supported attacks and stats only. No mitigation aura, resistance debuff, guardian healing, self-heal or unsupported talent bonus is budgeted.

revised_operational_plans.tactical_thesis: Replace the adjacent vanguard opening with an early defender and diagonally separated lower interception. Keep artillery damage, healing, four-lane interception and civilian release separately accountable. Use inexpensive eastern clearance support, preserve both professional medics after establishment, and replace temporary blockers through funded handoffs. This is an untested candidate; survival and actual targeting remain acceptance dependencies.

revised_stage_understanding.GameData_facts: The stage supplies four roadblocks, four hostile ground corridors, one flying artillery route and two neutral protected routes. Supplied operator stats, ranges and source routes ground this candidate.
revised_stage_understanding.UNKNOWN: New-formation target selection, roadblock destruction times, effective artillery damage windows, exact client timing and build equivalence remain unverified. Existing shell timestamps are observations of the old formation, not universal deadlines.
revised_stage_understanding.causal_revision: The prior opening treatment occurred, but adjacent patients and their healer died to shared artillery impacts. Later failed deployments arose from broken survival and income dependencies. Total caster damage did not establish sufficient artillery damage.
revised_stage_understanding.current_model_rules: Ordinary operators cannot attack or block civilians. Roadblocks specially detain them. Officers can attack them within 1.2. Successful retreats refund floor(actual deployment cost/2), release blocked enemies and start cooldown; deaths provide no refund.
revised_stage_understanding.validation_status: No stage simulation was run. Read-only shell inspection failed to start because of the environment's sandbox error; the plan uses supplied evidence and an arithmetic ledger only.

revised_strategic_hypotheses.hypothesis: An early defender, diagonally separated opening chokes, staged inexpensive clearance and permanent professional treatment can preserve four interceptions while replacing the prior medical-burst artillery policy.

predictions.falsification: Any opening blocker dies before its handoff, the first grant is missing, or a hostile passes an unstaffed corridor.
predictions.observable: Initial artillery impacts do not reproduce the three-operator shared death. Beagle survives until his retreat, Vanilla kills or continues holding her first raider and executes the first grant, and no hostile leaks through frame 1200.

predictions.falsification: Ground enemies or roadblocks consume the supposed windows, a caster dies before contributing, or artillery reaches its exit alive. No fixed kill frame is asserted.
predictions.observable: Both eastern arts stations land separately attributable artillery damage during actual visible visits, and their medical support prevents immediate caster loss.

predictions.falsification: A refund is missing, Noir Corne dies or leaks before replacement, cooldown is incomplete, or the returning defender fails to recapture the choke.
predictions.observable: After Beagle leaves, Noir Corne retains upper central enemies without a leak until Beagle returns; the returning Beagle then blocks a subsequent upper central hostile and survives an engagement.

revised_tactical_requirements.acceptance: Positive remaining life, zero leaks, zero protected deaths, two safe protected arrivals, exhausted spawns and no active enemies.
revised_tactical_requirements.artillery: Measure attacks and damage against enemy_1112_emppnt separately. Keep sustained arts coverage rather than withdrawing a professional medic for an assumed burst kill.
revised_tactical_requirements.execution_boundary: The timeline is a fixed candidate, not permission for a hidden retiming or life-saving controller. If a stated prerequisite fails, report the failed phase and causal dependency.
revised_tactical_requirements.handoffs: Check actual DP, successful retreat refunds, cooldown completion, replacement deployment and subsequent enemy recapture as one dependency chain.
revised_tactical_requirements.opening: Observe both survival and interception through the first four-corridor establishment; a heal alone is insufficient.
revised_tactical_requirements.protection: Record destruction of all four roadblocks, officer distances around detained civilians, outstanding projectile locks and two actual safe arrivals.

changed_responsibilities: Beagle owns opening upper survival instead of depending on two adjacent vanguards surviving shared shells.
Vanilla alone owns opening skill income; every later debit depends on her observed successful grants.
GALLUS and Plume own eastern roadblock damage; Jnight and Midnight own western clearance.
Hibiscus and Ansel remain professional treatment anchors after establishment instead of funding an unverified temporary Lava burst.
Noir Corne explicitly owns Beagle's entire retreat-to-return interception gap; merely executing the return command does not verify that gap.
revision_hypothesis.if_expected_event_absent: Inspect the actual first cast, locked point and victim set. Do not transplant old shell timing or infer safety from the missing event. Independently evaluate the declared opening survival and zero-leak prediction; reject the candidate if its survival or income chain fails.
revision_hypothesis.tactical_hypothesis: Replacing the shared-shell vanguard opening with a defender and separated interception positions, while retaining professional medics and assigning explicit roadblock duties, may preserve the survival and handoff chain needed for full-stage clearance. This remains conditional on observed targeting, temporary blocker survival and sufficient artillery damage.
